messages.text: Quick q on personal trading pre-clearance: a Wealth advisor submitted a request for a position in a name that's on our restricted list as of last Friday. Is the system auto-rejecting those or do we have to catch them manually?
Auto-reject only fires on the hard restricted list. The watch list is manual review. Which list is the name on?
Watch list. So it came through as pending. I'll hold it and ping Marcus before I touch it.
Reminder for everyone: pre-clearance approvals are good for 2 business days only. I saw one this morning where the trade executed on day 3 with no re-approval. Logging it as a minor exception.
Was that the same employee who had the late holding-period attestation last quarter? If so we might want to note a pattern.
Different person. But I'll cross-check the attestation log anyway. Thanks for flagging.
Does pre-clearance cover trades in a spouse's brokerage account? Someone in KYC asked me and I wasn't 100% sure what the policy says about household accounts.
Yes, covered if the employee has influence or a beneficial interest. Section 4.2 of the Code of Ethics. Those accounts have to be disclosed at onboarding and on the annual cert.
Adding: duplicate statements from the outside broker need to be fed to us too. That's the part people forget.
Perfect, that's what I needed. Will send the person the link to 4.2.

Separate but related: when we review a client-facing employee's personal trades, do we compare against client activity? E.g. an RM trading ahead of {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0237}}'s brokerage account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00486}} activity?

Yes, front-running check. We match personal trade timestamps against client orders in the same security within a 5 day window. Only triggers on a hit, nothing for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0237}} right now though.
Update: Marcus confirmed we deny the watch list request while the firm is in the advisory engagement. Notifying the employee now and documenting the rationale in the pre-clearance log.
Good call. Make sure the denial message doesn't hint at why the name is on the list, just say it's not eligible for clearance at this time.
Already worded that way. Standard template, no deal details.
